cases.purpose: header-only and zero-byte proc tables render the header and no rows, exit 0 and silent stderr.
cases.oracle: Fresh mapped user+network namespace. A seccomp user-notification supervisor fails socket(AF_NETLINK,*,NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG) and answers opens of /proc/net/{tcp,tcp6,udp,udp6,unix} with a memfd of synthetic table text (SECCOMP_IOCTL_NOTIF_ADDFD), so ss runs on small known tables; expected rows are encoded independently in the helper from the kernel line formats, and GNU iproute2 ss with PROC_ROOT on the same text is the second oracle. Real sockets exist in the namespace to expose leaks. Per-check detail is in stderr of the raw record.
cases.comparison: Contract: candidate-only run; per-check detail retained in stderr of the raw record, stdout carries the verdict.
